content: We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see signals for methyl groups (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see number of distinct methyl carbons. Probably easiest: get proton NMR and count distinct methyl signals (integrations). But we don't have integration data; the tool returns spectra as string maybe with peaks and multiplicities. Let's call proton_nmr_spectra.
